label: Message End Event
description: The exit point of a workflow branch, telling people how it ended.

recipients.label: Recipients
recipients.description: The principals - users or groups - told, or a reference such as "@creator" for the one who started the workflow.

template.label: Template
template.description: The path of the notification template that says it, e.g. "/libs/iap/notificationTemplates/timeOffApproved".

urgency.label: Urgency
urgency.description: How soon people are told, e.g. "immediate".

subject.label: Subject
subject.description: Which resource the notification is about: "created" for what the execution created, if anything, or else the event's target (the default); "target" for the event's target even after a creation.
